adhd.label: Step 1 · Jumps to Part I, Ch. 3–4: The 64 Arts & Sovereign Life of a Citizen (Start Here)
adhd.brief: Paints a vivid picture of the Nagarak (cultured citizen) in ancient India: a calm, well-appointed home with a lute hanging on the wall, painting supplies, garden swings, music, and warm evening adda with friends.

adhd.label: Step 2 · Jumps to Part I, Ch. 2 & Part III: Balancing Dharma, Artha & Kama and Courtship
adhd.brief: Shows why wealth and sensory joy are sacred when pursued without harming oneself, and how genuine romantic trust is built through unhurried playfulness and attentiveness.
